description: This file defines the TableChange interface and its nested classes representing various requested modifications to a table, such as adding/removing properties, columns, constraints, and altering column attributes within the Apache Spark SQL connector catalog.

classes.name: TableChange
classes.description: Interface representing requested changes to a table, with nested classes for specific change types.

classes.name: TableChange.SetProperty
classes.description: Represents setting or updating a table property.

classes.name: TableChange.AddColumn
classes.description: Represents adding a new column to the table.

classes.name: TableChange.UpdateColumnType
classes.description: Represents updating the data type of a column.

classes.name: TableChange.UpdateColumnNullability
classes.description: Represents updating the nullability of a column.

classes.name: TableChange.UpdateColumnComment
classes.description: Represents updating the comment of a column.

classes.name: TableChange.UpdateColumnPosition
classes.description: Represents changing the position of a column.

classes.name: TableChange.UpdateColumnDefaultValue
classes.description: Represents updating the default value of a column.

classes.name: TableChange.ColumnPosition
classes.description: Interface for column position specifications (FIRST, AFTER).

classes.name: TableChange.First
classes.description: Singleton class representing the FIRST position for a column.

classes.name: TableChange.After
classes.description: Represents positioning a column after another column.

classes.name: TableChange.ColumnChange
classes.description: Interface for changes to individual columns.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Creates a change to set or update a table property.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Creates a change to remove a table property.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Creates a change to add a new column with various overloads for specifying attributes.

methods.name: renameColumn
methods.description: Creates a change to rename a column.

methods.name: updateColumnType
methods.description: Creates a change to update a column's data type.

methods.name: updateColumnNullability
methods.description: Creates a change to update a column's nullability.

methods.name: updateColumnComment
methods.description: Creates a change to update a column's comment.

methods.name: updateColumnPosition
methods.description: Creates a change to update a column's position.

methods.name: updateColumnDefaultValue
methods.description: Creates a change to update a column's default value.

methods.name: deleteColumn
methods.description: Creates a change to delete a column.

methods.name: clusterBy
methods.description: Creates a change to set clustering columns.

methods.name: addConstraint
methods.description: Creates a change to add a table constraint.

methods.name: dropConstraint
methods.description: Creates a change to drop a table constraint.
